_comment: Subassembly names for dahlia_m1_full, passed to urdf_merge_subassemblies.py
Keyed by DRIVING JOINT, not by link name. Onshape renumbers part instances
between exports: one re-export swapped servo_horn_4hole_1 and _4 between the
base rotation and the shoulder, so a link-keyed map put the wrong name on the
wrong body while still validating cleanly. Joint names are authored, so they
'root' is keyed by link because no joint drives it, and is already named
sensibly, as is ef_gear. The clamps are exported as ef_clamp and ef_clamp_1,
so they are renamed by the prismatic joint that drives each side.
